Apr 14, 2022 #1

The Interledger community calls shall be once a month, on the second Wednesday of the month.

We’ll have 5 regular update slots from:

  • the Interledger Foundation,
  • Rafiki,
  • Fynbos,
  • Coil and
  • Open Payments teams,
    with additional slots open for anyone that would like to share their project or a discussion item for the broader community.

Vineel R. Pindi
May 20, 2022 #2

Hello everyone,

Here are the meeting minutes and recordings:

ILF Updates

  • Welcome Julaire Hall, our new Interledger Programs Outreach Manager
  • Announcing Grants for Interledger Protocol-Based Financial Services

Rafiki Updates

  • Open Payments API endpoints implemented; private incoming payments in Web Monetisation.
  • GNAP auth server - authorization flow
  • Milestones, issues, and weekly calls are now open to the community.
  • Two API endpoints - incoming and outgoing payments have cleaner code

Open Payments updates

  • Fairly standard risk methods - list (all incoming or outgoing payments)
    – get - update - delete resources
  • Web Monetization use case where - the browser pauses payment on a web page and instructs a wallet to send a payment to that payment pointer
  • More details on: Docs.openpayemnts.com

Fynbos update

  • Vendor agreements; launch in June as planned
  • Integrating Rafik into Fynbos Tech stack
  • A lot of work done on the Design side
  • Started integrating with the banking partner officially
